data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-I-H', meaning 'faith', 'belief', or 'conviction'. In Islamic tradition, Faihah represents the deep inner trust and certainty in Allah's guidance and wisdom. The name Faihah carries the meaning “Faith, Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faihah usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faihah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
